findings.origin: Retained lifetime gap, coordinator and independent audit
findings.issue: Old interaction code could deliver pending query results/errors after the attached common handle was replaced.
findings.resolution: Concrete handle plus logical generation guard, including recheck after subscriptions. Controlled pre-unit hook restoration fails both result/error cases; final guard passes.

findings.origin: Interaction guard exposed web handle churn, independent audit
findings.issue: Web adapter recreated common ref every commit, so ordinary updates incorrectly retired valid pending click results.
findings.resolution: Create stable handle via commit-time useImperativeHandle(..., []). Both selected web callback-update regressions fail before repair and pass afterward. Suspended callback regression retains committed behavior.

findings.origin: Introduced application routing error, coordinator audit
findings.issue: Initial migration assumed feature.layer/source metadata which native query GeoJSON does not promise.
findings.resolution: Use known application IDs and selected-layer result scope. Three actual-scene plain GeoJSON cases fail under old routing and pass after repair, including two-map routing. Proposal After example uses application routeIds and passes isolated declaration probe.

findings.resolution: Use commit-time factory with [] in both trees. Final publication-only rebuild, compiler, 276 source/276 compiled web regressions, lint with zero warnings and types pass; replace/recheck its archive. Original artifact unchanged. No exemptions.
